main:1.page: The Pillar of Autumn (Halo: Combat Evolved level)/Walkthrough
main:1.text: As soon as the first cutscene is over, you should see yourself climbing out of the cryotube. A flustered Thom Shephard will lead you out of the cryobay, but will soon be killed by a door exploding as it opens. Double back, you'll see a pair of pipes on your right (if you're facing away from the partially opened door), jump over it.
